harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent UFW host firewall on node1: SSH (22/tcp) allowed from anywhere, TCP 9000 allowed only from node2 (10.100.56.11), and rejected from node3 (10.100.56.12) and everywhere else. Verified functionally with live listener/connection tests, confirmed UFW enabled at boot, and performed the mandatory sequential restart of all three nodes with boot-ID proof of restart and post-restart re-verification.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (Ubuntu 24.04, ufw/nft/iptables available) and confirmed node2=10.100.56.11 / node3=10.100.56.12
Set ufw default deny incoming / allow outgoing on node1
Added ufw rule allowing SSH (22/tcp) from anywhere
Added ufw rule allowing 9000/tcp from node2 (10.100.56.11)
Added ufw rule rejecting 9000/tcp from node3 (10.100.56.12)
Added ufw rule rejecting 9000/tcp from anywhere else (catch-all)
Enabled ufw persistently (enabled at startup, active) and confirmed rule order via ufw status numbered verbose
Functionally verified: node2->node1:9000 succeeds, node3->node1:9000 refused, node3->node1:22 succeeds
Captured boot_id baseline on node1, node2, node3
Restarted node1 via background reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed ufw ruleset persisted and active, re-verified node2 allow / node3 reject behavior
Restarted node2, confirmed boot_id changed, re-verified node2 can still reach node1:9000
Restarted node3, confirmed boot_id changed, re-verified node3 still rejected on 9000 and SSH still reachable
Cleaned up temporary nc listener/test processes on node1

evidence.requirement: SSH allowed from anywhere on node1
evidence.summary: ufw status shows 22/tcp ALLOW IN Anywhere both before and after node1 restart; node3->node1:22 nc test succeeds.
ufw rule '9000/tcp ALLOW IN 10.100.56.11' present; nc from node2 to node1:9000 succeeds before restart, after node1's restart, and after node2's own restart.

evidence.requirement: TCP 9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else
evidence.summary: ufw rules reject 9000/tcp from 10.100.56.12 and from Anywhere; nc from node3 to node1:9000 returns 'Connection refused' before restart, after node1's restart, and after node3's own restart.
systemctl is-enabled/is-active ufw show enabled+active; ufw status verbose after node1 reboot shows identical ruleset to pre-reboot baseline.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart with changed boot identity and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 242af11e captured; reboot issued; connection timed out mid-reboot; new boot_id 8b4b99f6 confirms restart; post-restart ufw ruleset intact and firewall behavior (allow node2 / reject node3) re-verified with live nc tests.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart with changed boot identity and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 37344ae4 captured; reboot issued; connection timed out mid-reboot; new boot_id b7defb7a confirms restart; post-restart node2 successfully reconnects to node1:9000 confirming service/network recovery.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart with changed boot identity and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d70780a captured; reboot issued; connection timed out mid-reboot; new boot_id 6bf9e421 confirms restart; post-restart node3 remains rejected on 9000 and SSH still reachable, confirming firewall policy and network recovery.
